title: Gumball machine
prompt: a gumball machine where I can put in a coin and turn the crank; a gumball rolls down the chute; see-through shows the coin mechanism, dispensing wheel, agitator and chute
blurb: Drop in a quarter and turn the crank: the coin unlocks the drum, the gears turn the dispensing wheel a quarter turn, and one gumball falls through the floor and rolls down the chute to your hand.
